items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: The interviewee identifies Blind Freddy as the clarinet player with Wesley Dimes but provides no personal interaction or relationship with Wesley Dimes himself.

ctx.x: Did they read much music or mostly by ear? Oh yeah, especially down there was plenty of music from his wedding. And then after they got blue but he couldn't read no music. You remember blue? Yeah. Yeah, he got dead in a parade run.
Who was the clarinet with Wesley Dimes? How was he? No, clarinet. Who was the clarinet player with Wesley Dimes?

Well, we just had one kind of player. So who was he? Who was the clarinet player? Oh, uh, Blind Freddy. Blind Freddy. Yeah. I see. Blind Freddy was a clarinet player at that time. Bass? T-boy. He called him Eddie Gilmore. He called him T-boy. He worked out by T-boy. Let's see. Now uh... Fetty Boo Boo. Yeah, Thumbo. You know, we called him Fetty Boo Boo, but he was...
